title: i18n(field help): the extractor's `help ?? inlineHelpText ?? description` stops at `inlineHelpText: ''`, and a field authoring both texts gets the inlineHelpText translation on description
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Filing gate: ① two edges of the field-help derivation named by the #29153 implementer (os-dev-report 6573912237: a finding to file, plus open question [0], which the seat kept as ruled). They are out of PR #29217's claimed surface. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## The one derivation, three places

- The extractor scaffolds `objects.O.fields.F.help` from `field.help ?? field.inlineHelpText ?? field.description` (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` ≈L1489 on main).
- The console draws `inlineHelpText || description` (`fieldHelpText` in `@object-ui/fields`).
- After PR #29217, the resolver serves the `help` entry on `description`, and also on `inlineHelpText` when that is non-empty.

## Edge 1: `inlineHelpText: ''` (extractor)

`??` does not skip an empty string, so for a field with `inlineHelpText: ''` and a `description`, the extractor seeds `help` from `''`: no usable entry is scaffolded. The console treats `''` as absent and draws `description`, so that description is never offered for translation. The implementer probed this with `collectExpectedEntries`. Wanted: the extractor skips an empty `inlineHelpText` the way the console does (`||` semantics for that link, or an explicit non-empty check). Reader: `packages/cli` owner.

## Edge 2: both texts authored and different (resolver)

A field that authors `inlineHelpText: 'A'` and `description: 'B'` gets one `help` entry, seeded from A, and the resolver serves its translation on BOTH slots. So any reader of `description` (not the console's help line, which draws `inlineHelpText` first) sees the translation of A where the source says B. This predates PR #29217: the entry was always served on `description`. Ruling for #29153 kept it ("keeps serving `description` as today"). Wanted: a reading of whether `description` should take the `help` entry only when the extractor seeded it from `description` (no non-empty `inlineHelpText`), and which readers of a field's `description` exist besides the help line. Reader: `domain:spec` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`, `translateObject`).

Dedupe: searched `inlineHelpText extractor empty`, `field help translation description inlineHelpText`. Only #29153 and #25683. **New.**
